description:
Proves the log at size `second` is an append-only extension of the log
at size `first` — history was never rewritten. Returns both roots and
the proof path. Verify offline with
`scripts/verify-log.mjs consistency <proof.json>`.

Where a signed tree head is stored at `first` or `second`, that root
is checked against the current leaves; a mismatch (history rewritten
since the head was signed) answers 409 with no proof.
name: receipt_log_consistency_proof
